request.query: SELECT mu.mukey, mu.muname, c.compname, c.comppct_r, ch.hzdept_r, ch.hzdepb_r, ch.awc_r, ch.claytotal_r, ch.sandtotal_r, ch.om_r FROM SDA_Get_Mukey_from_intersection_with_WktWgs84('point(-93.62 42.03)') AS k INNER JOIN mapunit mu ON mu.mukey = k.mukey INNER JOIN component c ON c.mukey = mu.mukey AND c.majcompflag = 'Yes' LEFT JOIN chorizon ch ON ch.cokey = c.cokey ORDER BY c.comppct_r DESC, c.compname, ch.hzdept_r
